newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK foreign reserves US$63.6 billion at end April.
newsitem.headline: HK foreign reserves US$63.6 billion at end April.

text.p: Hong Kong hand foreign reserves of US$63.6 billion at the end of April excluding forward transactions yet to be settled, up from US$63.4 billion a month earlier, the government said on Thursday.
The increase was due to a seasonal increase in government placements of fiscal reserves with the exchange fund, it said.
Including forward transactions, foreign reserves reached US$67.6 billion at end April against US$67.7 billion at end March, it said.
